results.name: Kettlebell Shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a kettlebell in each hand by your sides using a neutral grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise both shoulders directly toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your upper back.
Lower your shoulders with control to the starting position, then repeat.
tips: Shrug your shoulders straight upward rather than rolling them.
Keep your neck relaxed and look straight ahead.
Lower your shoulders fully between repetitions.
Exhale as you shrug upward and inhale as you lower.
results.description: Kettlebell Shrug is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, bend your knees slightly, and hinge forward with your back straight. Hold a kettlebell in each hand using an overhand grip and let your arms hang straight down.
Keep your torso still and raise both shoulders upward toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your upper back while keeping your arms straight.
Lower your shoulders with control until your arms hang fully again, then repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows straight and avoid rowing the kettlebells.
Keep your neck aligned with your spine.
Keep your chest up and your torso still during each repetition.
Exhale as you shrug upward and inhale as you lower.
results.description: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Core, Lower Back.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a kettlebell by your side using a neutral grip.
Keep your arm straight, with a slight bend in the elbow, and raise the kettlebell out to the side.
Continue lifting until your arm reaches approximately shoulder height.
Lower the kettlebell with control to your side, then repeat before switching arms.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your elbow throughout the movement.
Raise your arm directly out to the side.
Keep your chest up and your torso still during each repetition.
Exhale as you raise the kettlebell and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Arm Lateral Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Rotator Cuff, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Stand in a wide stance with your left foot forward and your right leg extended back. Bend your knees slightly, lean forward, rest your left hand on your left thigh, and hold the kettlebell in your right hand using a neutral grip.
Let your right arm hang toward the floor with a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise the kettlebell out and backward until your arm reaches about shoulder height, squeezing your posterior deltoid.
Lower the kettlebell with control, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
tips: Keep your chest up and your torso still during each repetition.
Raise your right arm directly out to the side without turning it into a row.
Avoid shrugging your right shoulder or swinging the kettlebell.
Exhale as you raise the kettlebell and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Rotator Cuff, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Standing Bottoms-Up One Arm Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in your right hand with the bell facing up (bottoms-up position). Place your left hand on your hip.
Press the kettlebell overhead by extending your elbow, keeping your wrist straight.
Once your arm is fully extended overhead, pause for a second to fully activate the shoulder muscles.
Slowly lower the kettlebell back to the starting position with control, keeping the bottoms-up orientation throughout the movement. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a strong grip on the kettlebell to keep it stable in the bottoms-up position.
Start with a lighter weight to master the balance and control required for the bottoms-up position.
Avoid locking your elbow completely at the top of the press to protect your joint.
results.description: Kettlebell Standing Bottoms-Up One Arm Shoulder Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Kettlebell Upright Row
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands in front of your thighs.
Pull the kettlebell up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your elbows are at shoulder height.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Don't raise your elbows above your shoulders.
Keep the bell close to your body.
results.description: Kettlebell Upright Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps.

results.name: Landmine Alternating Single Arm Press
instructions: Stand facing the landmine with the end of the bar at one shoulder.
Brace your core and press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder.
Pass it to the other hand and press with that arm.
tips: Keep your ribs down.
Pass the bar under control.
results.description: Landmine Alternating Single Arm Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Chest, Core.

results.name: Landmine Half Kneeling Single Arm Overhead Press
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front, holding the end of the bar at your shoulder on the side of the down knee.
Squeeze the glute of the down leg and brace your core.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it with control and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your torso upright.
Don't lean away from the bar.
results.description: Landmine Half Kneeling Single Arm Overhead Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Core, Upper Chest.

results.name: Landmine Kneeling Alternating Overhead Press
instructions: Kneel tall on both knees facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar at one shoulder.
Press it up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder.
Switch hands and press with the other arm.
tips: Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips forward.
Keep the movement smooth.
results.description: Landmine Kneeling Alternating Overhead Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Core.

results.name: Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press
instructions: Kneel tall facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar at your chest with both hands.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower it to your chest and repeat.
tips: Don't arch your lower back.
Keep your elbows slightly in front of your body.
results.description: Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Chest, Core.
